sub_graphs.title: EIP-7805: Inclusion List Creation and Submission Lifecycle
sub_graphs.description: Models the lifecycle of FOCIL inclusion lists from committee selection through creation, signing, and network submission

nodes.label: New Slot Begins
nodes.description: A new slot has started, triggering inclusion list committee duties

nodes.label: Select Inclusion List Committee
nodes.description: Deterministically select INCLUSION_LIST_COMMITTEE_SIZE (16) validators using epoch seed with DOMAIN_INCLUSION_LIST_COMMITTEE, shuffling active validators

nodes.label: Inclusion List Committee Selected
nodes.description: 16 validators have been selected as the inclusion list committee for this slot

nodes.label: Create Inclusion List
nodes.description: Committee member creates an InclusionList containing slot, validator_index, inclusion_list_committee_root, and transactions (up to MAX_TRANSACTIONS_PER_PAYLOAD)

nodes.label: Inclusion List Created
nodes.description: InclusionList message has been constructed with forced-inclusion transactions

nodes.label: Sign Inclusion List with BLS
nodes.description: Committee member signs the InclusionList using BLS signature with DOMAIN_INCLUSION_LIST_COMMITTEE domain to produce SignedInclusionList

nodes.label: Signed Inclusion List Ready
nodes.description: SignedInclusionList is ready for network broadcast

nodes.label: Broadcast Inclusion List to Network
nodes.description: Publish SignedInclusionList on the inclusion_list gossip topic

nodes.label: Inclusion List Propagated
nodes.description: Inclusion list is available on the gossip network for block producers and other validators

external_entities.name: Transaction Mempool
external_entities.description: Source of pending transactions that committee members select for forced inclusion

sub_graphs.title: EIP-7805: Inclusion List Signature and Committee Validation
sub_graphs.description: Models the validation logic for verifying inclusion list authenticity and committee membership

nodes.label: Signed Inclusion List Received
nodes.description: A SignedInclusionList has been received and awaits validation

nodes.label: Compute and Verify Committee Membership
nodes.description: Recompute the inclusion list committee for the specified slot and verify the submitter's validator_index is a member

nodes.label: Verify Inclusion List BLS Signature
nodes.description: Extract validator pubkey from state, compute signing domain with DOMAIN_INCLUSION_LIST_COMMITTEE, and verify BLS signature via is_valid_inclusion_list_signature

nodes.label: Verify Committee Root
nodes.description: Verify that inclusion_list_committee_root matches the Merkle root of the actual committee for this slot

nodes.label: Inclusion List Valid
nodes.description: Inclusion list has passed all validation checks: committee membership, committee root, and BLS signature

nodes.label: Inclusion List Rejected
nodes.description: Inclusion list failed validation and is discarded

edges.label: Validator is committee member, verify root

external_entities.name: Inclusion List Submitter
external_entities.description: Network peer submitting a SignedInclusionList that must be validated before acceptance

sub_graphs.title: EIP-7805: Fork-Choice Enforced Inclusion Lists (FOCIL)
sub_graphs.description: Models how inclusion lists are enforced at the fork-choice level to ensure censorship resistance

nodes.label: Inclusion Lists Collected for Slot
nodes.description: Multiple valid inclusion lists from committee members have been collected for the current slot

nodes.label: Block Producer Checks Inclusion Lists
nodes.description: Block producer must verify that their proposed block includes the transactions specified in collected inclusion lists

nodes.label: Block Includes Forced Transactions
nodes.description: Proposed block contains the transactions mandated by the inclusion lists

nodes.label: Block Missing Forced Transactions
nodes.description: Proposed block is missing transactions required by inclusion lists

nodes.label: Fork Choice Evaluates IL Compliance
nodes.description: Fork choice rule evaluates whether a block satisfies inclusion list requirements; non-compliant blocks may be deprioritized

nodes.label: Block Accepted by Fork Choice
nodes.description: Block is accepted by the fork choice rule as IL-compliant

nodes.label: Block Deprioritized by Fork Choice
nodes.description: Block that fails IL compliance is deprioritized in the fork choice, reducing its chance of becoming canonical

edges.label: Submit compliant block for fork choice
Submit non-compliant block for fork choice

external_entities.name: Block Producer / Proposer
external_entities.description: Validator selected as block proposer who must incorporate inclusion list transactions into their block

ambiguities.text: The spec states committee size is 16 validators per slot but does not clarify what the minimum quorum is for inclusion list enforcement.
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume any valid inclusion list from any committee member creates an obligation. The fork choice enforcement mechanism determines the exact threshold. Needs cross-reference with fork-choice spec.

ambiguities.text: The relationship between inclusion_list_committee_root and the actual Merkle tree structure of the committee is not fully specified in the beacon-chain spec alone.
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume standard SSZ Merkle root of the list of committee validator indices.

ambiguities.text: The spec does not specify how block producers handle conflicting transactions across multiple inclusion lists from different committee members.
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume block producers must include the union of all transactions from all valid inclusion lists, with standard conflict resolution (e.g., nonce ordering).

implicit_assumptions.description: At least some of the 16 inclusion list committee members per slot are honest and will include censored transactions in their lists.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: If all 16 committee members collude to censor, FOCIL provides no censorship resistance for that slot.

implicit_assumptions.description: An attacker cannot predict and control which validators will be selected for the inclusion list committee far enough in advance to compromise them.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Targeted attacks on future committee members could enable planned censorship of specific transactions.

implicit_assumptions.description: Committee members have access to a representative mempool to select transactions for forced inclusion.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: If committee members have an empty or stale mempool, their inclusion lists may be empty, reducing censorship resistance.
